Name.en: Rarities that can be found in Sarnaut.

description.en:
Armor type: leather

Aspect: Attack, Support

Bards can come up with a song on any occasion. The striking lyrics and a captivating tune sow discord within the enemy's ranks or encourage allies.

Armor type: leather

Aspect: Attack, Support, Healing

In combat, Wardens call upon the forces of nature. And they always travel with their pet, who is a loyal friend and a trained helper in combat.

Armor type: leather

Aspect: Attack, Support

Engineers never go anywhere without their best friend, the gun mount. They also use standalone combat devices, tricky traps and chemical or explosive mines.

Armor type: cloth

Aspect: Attack, Support

The Mage controls the elements. Ice and fire, thunder and lightning - they are ready to unleash it all on their enemies.

Armor type: cloth

Aspect: Attack, Support, Healing

Summoners are never met alone; undead minions are their faithful allies. They use dark magic to spread diseases amongst their enemies, poison them and corrode their armor and flesh with acid. The very same dark magic allows them to heal their group members.

Armor type: plate

Aspect: Attack, Defense

Paladins are holy champions of the Light. The formidable warriors of melee combat and reliable defenders for their allies, they wear shiny plate armor and use magical barriers to withstand the most powerful blows.

Armor type: plate

Aspect: Attack, Support, Healing

Healers are bulwarks of the Light. The powers in their control can cinder their enemies in an instant, or heal most severe wounds of their allies. The most experienced of them are able to fight from a distance as well as in a melee combat.

Armor type: leather

Aspect: Attack, Support

The Psionicist prefers fighting with their mind. With but a thought, they can make their victims scream and writhe in terror and pain as they twist every single bone in their bodies.

Armor type: leather

Aspect: Attack, Defense

Scouts prefer to shoot their enchanted arrows from a distance, but they can easily switch to close combat, snaring their opponents or knocking them down. Versatile fighters who rely on quick reflexes, speed and agility, they provoke their enemy and dodge their blows, at the same time granting excellent protection for their group.

Armor type: cloth

Aspect: Attack, Defense

Demonologists are powerful mages who use demonic powers and occult knowledge to efficiently dispose of their enemies. Their secret knowledge allows them to assume forms of various demonic entities, each with their own advantages and drawbacks.

Armor type: plate

Aspect: Attack, Defense

Warriors are specialists of melee combat. All existing kinds of weapons serve them equally well when it comes to smashing their enemies into the ground.

@636.en: I knew this trip would bring no luck!

@868.en: I'll feed you to the fish!

@404.en: I'll bury you!

Lightning bolts shall strike your defenseless flesh, wingless ones!

@404.en: Freeze! You here to steal something?

@636.en: The sanitarium is done for... Forgive me, Yasker, I have failed...

@868.en: I'll throw you out into the frosty air... With nothing but underwear on, ha-ha!

@404.en: In the name of the Queen!

@636.en: Brothers... How can it be true?

@404.en: Ah, more lunatics? Or they are sane? There can be only one decision - kill them!

@868.en: Tep will happily accept your Soul!

@636.en: Holy Tensess, accept your loyal servant...

@404.en: Here comes blood!!!

We don’t have guests here often.

@868.en: Make yourself comfortable, get used to the soil.

@788.en: Xadaganian workmen and red aviaks are brothers forever!

@404.en: Die! Rot! Taint!
